title: Goemon: New Age Shutsudou! - Edo Highway
description:
The background seen in one of the stages from the very unusual Goemon: New Age Shutsudou! for the Game Boy Advance. There's a lot of free space in BG3, so it is possible to use it with a lot of foreground decoration. A good fit for ruined cities, in general.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
